ideas.name: Futures Roll Spread Volatility
ideas.claim: In the study's U.S. equity index futures sample, calendar spread volatility rose as expiration approached.
ideas.quote: In the U.S., India, and China, spread volatility is confirmed to rise as expiration approaches.
ideas.mechanism: Position rollover flows concentrate in front-to-back futures calendar spreads as expiration approaches.

rules.timeframe: Daily; 15 trading days prior to and including front-month expiration

not_stated: magnitude of the U.S. spread-volatility increase
ideas.claimed_result: Spread volatility rose as expiration approached in the 2016 U.S. sample; the paper does not state a directional return in the quoted finding.
required_data: Front- and back-month S&P 500 E-mini futures prices
